item.text: The legacy generic painter validates canvas/spec shape before dispatch, and its primitive rectangle conversion rejects coordinate-plus-size overflow before writing. In Rust, `widget_paint` already had an additional 128-point checked margin for painter-internal offsets. I’ve factored that exact bounds check into a shared preflight and applied it to the direct TreeRow and EmptyState methods, so they reject before their first paint operation. The new tests use icon-fitting dimensions and near-limit coordinates that previously reached unchecked offsets.
